name: python
description: Python: uv workspaces, pytest with coverage.py, ruff, mypy.
firstSteps: Python: run `uv lock` once and commit `uv.lock`. The scaffold cannot write it, and CI installs with `uv sync --locked`, so CI is red until the file exists.

package-manager.fills: uv workspaces: `uv sync --locked` installs, uv.lock is the lock file, the workspace members are the packages (`[tool.uv.workspace]` of the root pyproject.toml)

coverage-packages.fills: the uv workspace members that carry a coverage gate (coveragePackages of the profile file); each keeps its sources in src/ and its tests in tests/

test-runner.fills: pytest through `uv run`, run from the package: `uv run coverage run -m pytest`

coverage-tool.fills: coverage.py (branch coverage) run from the package with the root configuration; its JSON report `<package>/coverage/coverage.json` is the raw coverage, and `harness coverage summarize` writes the neutral summary coverage/coverage-summary.json from it

coverage-merge.fills: adds up what the shards of coverage.py's JSON report executed (lines, branches, functions) and writes the neutral summary

linter.fills: ruff check, with the rules E, F, I, B, UP, ANN (a typed public boundary) and T20 (no print left behind)

formatter.fills: ruff format, run from the project's own environment only: `uv run --no-sync ruff format`

typecheck.fills: mypy in strict mode through `uv run mypy`

version-file.fills: pyproject.toml, the `version` of its [project] table (release.versionFiles of the profile file)

local-gate-plan.fills: ruff check, mypy and the format check of the touched packages, the whole test suite with coverage of each touched package (pytest cannot follow a file to its tests), and the changed-file coverage

ci-job-layout.fills: a static job and a coverage job per package, which keep coverage.py's JSON report for the aggregator

commands.fills: uv run ruff, mypy, pytest and coverage, and the framework's tools through node (the commands of the profile file)

ignore-files.fills: the root pyproject.toml, whose `extend-exclude` of ruff (and `exclude` of mypy) names the vendored framework

scaffold-files.fills: `.python-version`, `.nvmrc` (the harness tools run on Node), a root `pyproject.toml` with the uv workspace, the development tools and the configuration of ruff, mypy and coverage.py, a `pyproject.toml`, a first module and its test in each package (at the root when the project has none), and the ignore lines of its tools; no uv.lock, which the project creates with `uv lock`

quiet-commands.fills: `--quiet` for Ruff, `--no-error-summary` for mypy and `-q` for pytest; the gate's steps use the same options

dependency-audit.fills: the dependency files (`pyproject.toml` with one of the lock files of uv, Poetry or PDM, and `requirements*.txt`, which are their own record), the requirements in them that have no upper bound, and the audit command `uv run pip-audit`

enforces.by: the pre-push gate holds the changed files of a touched package (`harness coverage check-changed`)
CI merges the coverage of the shards and holds each package and every changed file to the gate
CI runs the tests of every package
ruff (ANN) and mypy of the touched packages in the pre-push gate
ruff (T20 for debug printing) of the touched packages in the pre-push gate

versions.runtime: Python 3.12 (the harness tools run on Node.js 22 LTS)
